title: Aureate - Stats, Combo & How to Get

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Aureate is a one-handed blade in Phantom Blade Zero's primary weapon set. Mimics Zuo Shang's Golden Sword Energy, which makes it the one weapon on the list that copies a boss moveset instead of a damage type.

sections.title: Weapon Class and Slot
sections.content: Aureate occupies the Primary slot, and it is classed as One-handed. Soul carries two primary blades and two secondary Phantom Edges at once, and switching between the four refills stamina rather than costing it - which is what keeps a combo chain running. Sha-chi is a separate pool, spent on heavy attacks and blocks. The full class lists are on the blade index.

sections.title: Stats and Effects
sections.content: Not confirmed post-launch. Phantom Blade Zero does not publish a numeric stat sheet for individual weapons, and no measurement of this one has been recorded, so no damage, scaling or speed figure is given here. A number invented from how the weapon looks is exactly the kind of filler this page exists to avoid.

sections.title: How It Plays
sections.content:
The reason to carry it is its property rather than a damage number: Mimics Zuo Shang's Golden Sword Energy.

Switching to it mid-combo refills stamina, so its practical job is to extend a chain past the point where the blade you were using runs dry. See the combat system for how the swap window works.

sections.title: How to Obtain
sections.content:
Defeat Zuo Shang at Mount Soulrend.

Dropped by Zuo Shang - see that page for the fight itself, and boss drops for the reverse list.

Acquisition points are taken from the acquisition table on the weapons hub, which is kept in step with this page - if a route is corrected there, it is corrected here.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: This page tracks Aureate in Phantom Blade Zero. Anything marked “not confirmed post-launch” has not been published or measured yet; see the weapons list for the system as a whole.
